requiredFiles.description: 150-word written explanation of a non-obvious CSS decision

criteria: All styles are in the external styles.css file — no inline styles (style='...') appear anywhere in index.html
CSS uses either Flexbox or Grid (or both) for at least one layout section, demonstrating understanding of the layout model
The page is responsive and usable at three breakpoints: 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), and 1280px (desktop) using media queries
The CSS demonstrates understanding of the box model: margin, padding, and border are used intentionally and correctly
REFLECTION.md contains at least 120 words explaining a specific, non-obvious CSS decision the student made — not a generic description of what CSS does
